input.prompt: Your task is to calculate surface energy of the given material in (001) direction. Retrieve the structure of Silicon from the Materials Project database with mp-149 as the Materials Project ID and save it in the LAMMPS data format. Use 'full' as atom style. Perform energy minimisation using the reaxff potential and use conjugate gradient as the minimiser, with force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 1e-10, maximum iterations of 1e+5 and maximum evaluations of 1e+5. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions, use real units, full atom style, and set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. After minimizing the bulk system, introduce a (001) surface by removing periodicity in the z-direction. Re-minimize the slab system and compute the surface energy in kcal/(mol Å²) unit. As the final output, return the computed surface energy value.
